key_insight: Quantum-classical branch and bound can certify globally optimal low-autocorrelation binary sequences (LABS), with correctness independent of the quantum sampler.
engineering_relevance: Certified LABS optimization supports the design of pulse-compression radar phase codes and digital-communication synchronization words.
method: Use fixed-angle QAOA on native quartic node Hamiltonians without penalty terms.
Use quantum samples to propose candidate sequences and guide branching; apply classical bounds to prune.
Return a proof of optimality or, if stopped early, the best sequence found with a certified lower bound and gap.
evidence_signal: Reported runs at QAOA depths p=12 and p=1 with 1,000 shots per sampled node proved optima for lengths 2–30; from length 27 onward, roots were split without sampling.
watch_item: No speedup is claimed, and the reported results do not establish scalability beyond length 30.
paper_title: Proven optimality for LABS with quantum-classical branch and bound
